info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Order Processing API
info.description: The Order Processing API facilitates the management of operational tasks related to order processing within banking services. This endpoint allows users to initiate the processing of customer orders, ensuring accurate and timely handling of transactions. Typical consumers include financial institutions and developers integrating banking services into their applications. It is designed to enhance operational efficiency and improve customer satisfaction by streamlining order management workflows.

post.summary: Process an order through operational services.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to process a customer order by submitting the required order details. It initiates the operational workflow necessary to fulfill the order based on the provided information.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information for processing an order within the operational services. The payload should adhere to the defined schema, ensuring that all required fields are included and correctly formatted.
